Map Name: Formorgar III
Gamemode: Nebula DTM
Map Creator: UmbreonMessiah
Helpers: ElectraXdroid, LeafeonMessiah
Contributors: FlareonMessiah, FlufflesSub, JolteonMessiah, alexanderjoe10
General Information:
- 2 Teams - Prospit vs Derse
- 20 vs 20
- Same loadout as Formorgar I & Formorgar II (Updated all three and made it the same)
- 2 Monuments (Left & Right)
- 1 Beacon & 3 Enchantment Tables (Only 1 protected)
- Bookshelves & Gold Blocks that yield Exp Bottles
- Very fun and very amazing and very awesome ok (and also a sexy shape)

replies.body: Nice map indeed but, I don't see much of a difference between Formorgar II and Formorgar III. They are almost the same thing. Notice that Formorgar I and Formorgar II are different but, you can see why they are in the same series of maps.

replies.body: It's a very nice map, and would like to see it get into the rotation. I do agree with PokerFace and Atdit, it is very similar. I would like to see some maps with more of a hilly surface rather than a flat one. But I would say +1 :)
